arguments.command:
git checkout --theirs README.md && python3 - <<'E'
p='README.md';s=open(p).read()
old="| `model_max_tokens` | Maximum output tokens of the custom model | No | `16384` |"
new="| `model_max_tokens` | Maximum output tokens of the custom model (reasoning counts toward it). A response that hits it with no tool call is continued, up to 3 times in a row and within `timeout`; partial text is posted, marked as cut off. If it keeps hitting the limit, pi posts an error that says so: raise this value, up to the provider's limit for the model | No | `16384` |"
assert old in s; open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
E
grep -rn "summary\|max_tokens" docs/ | head
